The gym environment features wood-paneled walls and various metal exercise machines in the background. (2) He transitions to a sitting position where he demonstrates a reverse grip movement with a dumbbell, looking directly at the camera while speaking. (3) The camera captures a close-up of his right upper arm and forearm as he points to specific muscle groups, his skin glistening with sweat under bright studio-style lighting. (4) He stands up and performs heavy hammer curls with large black dumbbells in a side-profile view, showcasing the extension and contraction of his arm muscles. (5) He switches to a barbell with green Rogue weight plates, demonstrating reverse curls with a focused facial expression and controlled tempo. (6) He sits back on the bench, gesturing with both hands to emphasize his points while explaining the differences between the exercises. visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 欸蓋伊 錘式彎舉是練哪. (2) [Subtitle]: 肱橈肌. (3) [Subtitle]: 那反向彎舉呢. (4) [Subtitle]: 肱橈肌. (5) [Subtitle]: 這兩個動作差在哪. (6) [Subtitle]: 錘式彎舉 主要鍛鍊我們的 肱橈肌 肱肌 還會有肱二頭肌的參與. (7) [Subtitle]: 它可以讓你手臂整體 更厚實 更飽滿 提升整體手臂外側線條. (8) [Subtitle]: 反向彎舉則可以 更孤立肱橈肌 並增加更多的 前臂伸肌群. (9) [Subtitle]: 比如你看到的 伸屈腕 伸屈指 能讓你的前臂線條 整體雕刻度更完美. (10) [Subtitle]: 那我是不是 練反向彎舉就好. (11) [Subtitle]: 有一個重點 肉量呢 是需要靠重量去堆疊 通常錘式彎舉 可以用更大的重量. (12) [Subtitle]: 以我自己來說 錘式 我可以用雙手45公斤 10下做組. (13) [Subtitle]: 但反向彎舉 我只能用30公斤 10下做組. (14) [Subtitle]: 所以還是會建議大家 訓練手臂以二頭彎舉 錘式彎舉為主 反向彎舉為輔. [Slogan]: 錘式 45公斤. [Slogan]: 反向 30公斤.
